alt: Teen drum corps and flag line in green uniforms march past a packed Howard Street sidewalk crowd in the July 4 parade.
Marching band in red and blue with flag bearers turns down Howard Street while townspeople watch from the curb.
Parade float with costumed riders and a dense crowd of kids and teens lining Howard Street.
Big marching band in red jackets and white pants fills Howard Street in front of Mr. Tony's and Murdick's Fudge.
Downtown Howard Street storefronts with Fryman's and a restaurant sign, parked cars at the curb.
Little Caesars Pizza Parlor ad: Disco Top Deck, dancing, 'Go where it's at'.
Petoskey High marching band members in jeans play clarinets and sax while walking a field.
A girl and boy in thrift-store-chic clothes sit on a bench in front of dark windows at a school event.
McDonald's of Petoskey congratulations ad to the Class of '80 with golden arches logo.
A student in a long wig and beard Halloween mask raises his arms in a dark crowd at a school Halloween event.
Mighty Fine Pizza ad, 222 East Mitchell, open 4 PM daily, pizza to go and delivery.
A senior in a striped shirt flings his arms wide in a school hallway rehearsing for the Senior Gong Show.
Pied Piper of Hamlin roller skating rink ad with the log rink building, weekend skating and stereo.
A girl in a feathered cap gestures mid-skit in a crowded French class Christmas party.
Yearbook staff piled in a human pyramid against a brick wall, grinning at the camera.
A guy in a cowboy hat and western shirt boogies to disco at the Sadie Hawkins dance.
Two dance-goers mug for the camera, one laughing and one waving a hand, at the Sadie Hawkins dance.
A boy with glasses talks to a girl whose sweater back carries a yarn doll patch at the Sadie Hawkins dance.
Teens in oversized yellow sunglasses and a number 5 football jersey dance close at the Halloween dance.
Two mobsters in fedoras and suits mug on the dance floor next to a girl in a clown costume.
Students in homemade papier-mache Halloween masks lounge on a rock and grass outside school.
Students sprawled on the sidewalk and grass at the school picnic, laughing, a van parked behind.
Student council members lounge on desks and chairs in a classroom with files behind them.
A tuxedoed boy laughing wide-mouthed holds hands with his corsaged prom date at the 1980 Junior-Senior Prom.
A girl in a big knit scarf and a blond boy hug and grin for the camera in a school hallway.
Two seniors on a brick-wall floor smile and hold a hand-lettered 'Won't You Be Mine?' sign.
Honor society students lean against a brick wall in sweaters and turtlenecks, one holding a fire extinguisher.
A packed bleacher crowd of teens cheering at a pep assembly, jackets and feathered hair.
Night football game, helmeted linemen set at the line of scrimmage with a referee behind.
Cheerleaders in letter sweaters throw their arms up at a night football game.
Homecoming parade: majorettes in white boots and a big band in C uniforms march down the street at night.
Three football coaches in windbreakers stand with their backs to the camera under the scoreboard lights.
A helmeted football player number 11 listens to a coach in a satin jacket on the sideline at night.
Football players seen from behind lined up on the sideline at night, jerseys 61 and 64.
A football player in a mud-streaked jersey clutches the ball after a catch under the lights.
